description: Test suite for the Attributes Store in Mattermost, including functions for creating test users, refreshing attributes, searching users, and managing channel members based on user attributes.

methods.name: TestAttributesStore
methods.description: Main test function executing sub-tests for attribute refresh, user search, and channel member management.

methods.name: createTestUsers
methods.description: Creates test users with specific attributes and property values, and provides cleanup function.

methods.name: testAttributesStoreRefresh
methods.description: Tests the refresh of attributes and retrieval of subjects.

methods.name: testAttributesStoreSearchUsers
methods.description: Tests various user search scenarios based on attributes, limits, and pagination.

methods.name: testAttributesStoreGetChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Tests retrieval of channel members to remove based on attribute queries.

methods.name: testAttributesStoreSearchUsersBySubjectID
methods.description: Tests searching users by specific SubjectID and with query filters.
